Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — your co-pilot for the Unitree G1. Here’s what we can do together:

🤖 Poses  
"Make the robot wave its right hand"  
"Sit the robot down on the ground"  
"Turn the robot’s torso to face left"

✋ Hands  
"Open and close the left hand like a fist"  
"Point the right index finger forward"  
"Make both hands give a thumbs‑up gesture"
